guidance.box_rule: Tight AABB encloses owned visible front material, including its own frontal rim. Background/rack/gripper may fall inside around a tilted face or between owned patches; those pixels must not alone set external extrema. Remove an outer strip only when it contains no required target material.
guidance.corner_rule: Actual lower-front edge/side junction, ordered by imageX. Not necessarily the box corner, brightest stripe, inner groove or projecting upper cap. Color supports ownership; contour continuity, plane changes and occlusion evidence determine it.
guidance.uncertainty_rule: Usev2 for a visible locatable rounded/soft junction; preserve0 0 0 for hidden or materially ambiguous coordinates. Do not infer from predictions, symmetry, neighboring frames or box boundaries.
guidance.axis_rule: Imagex increases right: xmin=left,xmax=right. User wording right borderline(xmin) should be interpreted physically and documented; decreasingxmax is moving the right boundary left.
